cosaCuro.lead: Shoulder and upper-limb specialist. Sports trauma. In hospital, hip and knee as well. Ultrasound is a tool of the visit, not a separate service.

cosaCuro.disclaimer: These pages inform; they do not replace a consultation. Every case is assessed in person.
